FN-4U98SRI-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 87
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Chris Sells
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 01/12/2026
House Bill 87 as introduced would, beginning in Fiscal Year 2027, decrease sales tax receipts to
the Education Trust Fund by an undetermined amount dependent upon the amount of gross
receipts derived from the sale of deer feed, exempted by the bill.
This bill would also decrease sales tax receipts to county and municipal funds of local
governments by an undetermined amount dependent upon the amount of gross receipts derived
from the sale of deer feed and the applicable local tax rate.

FN-4U98SRI-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 87
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Chris Sells
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 01/14/2026
House Bill 87 as reported by the committee on Ways and Means Education would, beginning in
Fiscal Year 2027, decrease sales tax receipts to the Education Trust Fund by an undetermined
amount dependent upon the amount of gross receipts derived from the sale of deer feed,
exempted by the bill. This bill could also decrease sales tax receipts to county and municipal
funds of local governments by an undetermined amount if the respective local governments
adopt an exemption from local sales and use taxes pursuant to this bill.
